The original title claimed C2 necessity, exceeding the Statement restriction to the supplied smooth construction. Coorientation preserves side j, and conjugation transports small positive parameters to small positive parameters, so null displaced loops remain null. Reviewed finite based-homotopy/fence comparison and product/inverse closure. Statement unchanged.

F1/F2 supplied only maximal-center outer-frontier data, so their application to arbitrary circuits and either adjacent annulus was unlicensed. Consulted Haefliger section 4.2, pp.390-392; it concerns a selected one-sided holonomy cycle and is not used as a proof of this broader adapter.
